avis.texte: This lotion is amazing! AMAZING! I bought it because I found out I had an allergy to fragrance and fortunately Cetaphil doesn’t have any fragrance/perfume. My doctor recommended it for my itchy dry legs. It works great on my dry skin. Definitely not as itchy. Additionally, I used to have a patch of rough bumpy skin on my upper arm that has been there for years. Never thought much of it cause I could feel it more than I could see it. As I got older it would get pink at times but I’d had bumps on my arm for so long I didn’t think anything of it. Like permanent goosebumps. It completely went away when I started using Cetaphil after my showers. I went to touch it instinctively and it was gone in less than a week. Amazing! Anyway, itchiness from dry skin gone, bumps gone, and no fragrance means this is a winner in my book.

avis.titre: Cetaphil is a GREAT product. Read my review to see why - I dare you!!
avis.texte: WOW!! I was so surprised by this product. This is NO, I mean absolutely NO scent at all but boy, does it work. As I've gotten older I've found my skin has gotten really funky - as in, it's so much drier, gets irritated by certain fibers, reacts to weather conditions - really weird things. I got tired of trying the cheaper, big mouth products and decided to try the one I saw got rave reviews from a number sources. So glad I finally woke up and made the switch to Cetaphil. Within minutes my skin "screamed " THANK YOU DUMMY - WHY DIDN'T YOU DO THIS SOONER " Look, I'm not kidding, I'm 73 years old and have used a lot of products over the years. I had a favorite one for years that worked for me but then, it started not performing for these new issues. To be honest, I didn't want to spend the money with so many other brands, less expensive, touting their hype. Cetaphil is worth ever cent and then some. An added incentive is that it doesn't leave a greasy feel after applying it. I know this is a long review but I wanted you people to have an honest, full blown assessment of this product.

avis.titre: I have to say I like this lotion better than any other ones I have ...
avis.texte: Thought I had already given this product a review. I have to say I like this lotion better than any other ones I have tried. I could feel the difference in the ultra hydrating it has in this product. I've used many other products and this one is the best so far. ItI does not have any fragrance in case a viewer has allergy or does not want a purfume smell in their lotion. I would highly recommend this for anyone who works in the medical/dermatologist field to suggest this to use this on/for their patients. I was recommended Cetaphil products years ago and they have never been a problem for my very sensitive skin.

This has been my go to lotion for years. I switched from Vanicream as I found it to be too heavy. This lotion can feel greasy right after applying but it does sink in after about 15-20 mins. I apply right after showering and wear a light robe while I do my hair/makeup so by the time I get dressed it's fine. I have very sensitive skin and not able to use scented lotions, body washes, or laundry detergents and this lotion does not aggravate my skin at all. I've noticed over the years that the price has increased however it still works better for me than even higher priced lotions. I recommend this for anyone who has sensitive skin.

avis.titre: My dermatologist recommended this as being the best for the super dry skin I have
avis.texte: I subscrib to this and that alone saves a bundle. This product tends to be higher priced then other but for a very good reason. There arent any irritants and if applied after a shower or bath it obsorbs into the skin incredible fast. On dry skin it simple takes just a litte bit longer. With my overly sensitive skin its taken years for me to find something that works and doesnt make me feel like im wearing glue all day on my skin. You dont need to use a ton of it, nor do you have to use it multiple times a day. The secret is to use it regularly and occationaly an additional time during the day if needed. Ive had rough areas of skin that have been there for years and figured I just had to live with it. In less than a week these areas were notivably smoother. It is well worth the price

My husband came home from work one day and mentioned a friend had recommended this lotion for dry hands. I have to say this is a great lotion for many reasons. My husbands hands get quite dirty and he found that if he used this lotion before starting work when lunch rolled around and he washed his hands the dirt rinsed right off. He would then follow with another application. It also kept his hands hydrated and kept them from drying out and cracking from the harsh chemicals and cleaners they use for his job. For myself, I have always had a problem with the heels of my feet being so dry and this lotion remedied that issue. This past winter no problem with dry flaky skin. It kept my skin hydrated. This lotion is not greasy and has no odor. I use it on my face without issue as well but I've always had dry skin. It's become a must have for our family!
